svg.title: Food scientist — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as food scientist, wearing a protective coat and a hair covering. Visible work cue: A rounded food sample sits on a shallow laboratory dish while a separate probe approaches its surface. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hair covering and round glasses.
